targets.speaker: ALEX
targets.target: What happens when demand for AI outruns the infrastructure underneath it?

targets.speaker: JAMIE
targets.target: The simple version is this: the constraint created when demand for intelligence outruns chips, power, data centers, or inference economics.

targets.speaker: JAMIE
targets.target: The scary part is not the average result. It is the person, patient, team, or company living inside the exception.

targets.speaker: RUFUS
targets.target: Lovely. We have automated the decision and preserved the blame. Very efficient, in the bleakest possible sense.

targets.speaker: JAMIE
targets.target: Think of it like a brilliant restaurant with one stove, a mile-long queue, and customers ordering more every minute.

targets.speaker: ALEX
targets.target: Do not ask only what launched. Ask what new permission, risk, cost, or accountability chain just appeared.

targets.speaker: RUFUS
targets.target: The question for tomorrow is not whether compute bottleneck sounds clever. It is who gets caught when it becomes real.
